castle.instructions: Drag a rock off a pile, then flick it
castle.tooFast: Too hasty! Heavy rocks need a gentler throw
castle.unsteady: Steady now: one slow, smooth push
castle.slip: Ease it off the pile, slowly

hat.instructions: Flick a card into the hat
hat.tiltHint: Tilt your phone to steer it in the air

cut.instructions: Flick cards up from the bottom
cut.keepGoing: Slice the fruit, pop the balloons

flush.instructions: Pull back the sling and let go
flush.goal: Land a flush, a straight or a full house
flush.bust: Bust! No hand left to make

board.instructions: Push a card up the table into the zones
board.sweepHint: Rub ahead of a sliding card to sweep it on

architect.instructions: Take a card from the tray; lean two together
architect.turnHint: Turn a card flat with a second finger for a floor
